Working notes: intake batches ORD-5100–ORD-5109.

Form version 1 fields: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country.

Observed outcomes:
- All attempts rejected with -0.20. Invalid fields were always priority, and often also ship_country.
- Priority appears to be the consistent blocker; ship_country is invalid in most but not all rejections.
- Each record gets up to 3 attempts. After 3 rejections, it goes to manual review.
- No successful auto-intake observed.

Useful rules:
- Before submitting, validate and normalize both priority and ship_country. Do not rely on front-desk notes like “ordinary priority,” “customer asked for confirmation,” or “duplicate check done” to mean the fields are valid.
- Source records are often truncated or malformed pasted JSON. Do not infer missing values from the visible excerpt; obtain the full source/complete fields before deciding.
- If the first attempt fails on priority, fixing priority may still leave ship_country invalid. Check both.
- If two attempts fail, the third is likely to fail unless the actual missing/invalid fields are corrected; otherwise expect manual review.

Next batch: prioritize full field validation, especially priority and ship_country.

Working notes: intake batches ORD-5100–ORD-5119.

Form v1/v2 fields: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country. V2 shows frequent qty rejections; validate qty too.

Observed:
- All attempts rejected -0.20. No successful auto-intake.
- Common invalid: priority, ship_country, qty. Priority is frequent but not universal (sometimes only ship_country; sometimes no priority). V2 often includes qty.
- Multiple invalid fields common. Fixing one may reveal another (e.g., priority then ship_country). Invalid sets can include cust/email when source is empty/truncated.
- Each record max 3 attempts; then manual review. Batches may arrive at attempt 2/3, so remaining tries are limited.
- Source records are often truncated pasted JSON/emails/phone notes; did/JSON may end mid-field or be blank. Do not infer missing values.

Rules:
- Before submitting, obtain full source and validate/normalize all fields, especially priority, ship_country, qty; for v2 treat qty as high risk.
- Front-desk notes (“ordinary priority,” “confirmation email,” “partner portal,” etc.) are not field validation.
- Check attempt number. If attempt 3, submit only after all invalid fields are corrected; otherwise expect manual review.
- If rejection lists multiple invalid fields, correct all before retry. Do not assume a prior field was accepted.
- Manual review after 3 rejections; continue to next record.

Next batch: full-field validation, attempt count, priority/ship_country/qty.

Working notes: intake batches ORD-5100–ORD-5129.

Form v1/v2 fields: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country. V2: validate all; qty high risk.

Observed:
- All attempts rejected -0.20. No successful auto-intake.
- In ORD-5120–5129, invalid fields: priority (all 10), qty (7/10), ship_country (5/10). Common sets: priority+qty; priority+ship_country; priority+qty+ship_country.
- Multiple invalid fields common. Fixing one may reveal another. Invalid sets can include cust/email if source empty/truncated.
- Source records often truncated pasted JSON/emails/phone/voicemail notes; JSON may end mid-field or be blank. Do not infer missing values.
- Each record max 3 attempts; then manual review. Batches may arrive at attempt 2/3, so remaining tries limited. At attempt 3, any rejection sends record to manual review.

Rules:
- Before submitting, obtain full source and validate/normalize all fields, especially priority, ship_country, qty. For v2 treat qty as high risk.
- Front-desk notes (“ordinary priority,” “confirmation email,” “partner portal,” “duplicate check,” etc.) are not field validation.
- Check attempt number. If attempt 3, submit only after all invalid fields are corrected; otherwise expect manual review.
- If rejection lists multiple invalid fields, correct all before retry. Do not assume a prior field was accepted.
- Manual review after 3 rejections; continue to next record.

Next batch: full-field validation, attempt count, priority/ship_country/qty.

Working notes: intake batches through ORD-5139.

Forms v1–v3 fields: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country. V2: qty high risk. V3: order_date high risk; priority, qty, ship_country also often invalid. All fields can be invalid.

Observed:
- All attempts rejected -0.20. No successful auto-intake.
- ORD-5130–5139: order_date invalid 10/10. priority/qty/ship_country frequent. Invalid sets often include order_date+priority+qty+ship_country, order_date+priority+qty, order_date+priority+ship_country, etc.
- Multiple invalid fields common; fixing one may reveal another. Do not assume any field was accepted.
- Source records often truncated voicemail/phone/handwritten transcriptions; JSON may end mid-field or be blank. Do not infer missing values.
- Front-desk notes (“ordinary priority,” “confirmation email,” “partner portal,” “duplicate check,” “handwritten; transcribed by reception,” etc.) are not field validation.
- Each record max 3 attempts; then manual review. Batches may arrive at attempt 2/3. At attempt 3, any rejection sends record to manual review.
- For v3, order_date formats seen: 2026-06-03, 06/03/2026, 02/15/2026—all invalid; need correct format/source.

Rules:
- Before submitting, obtain full source and validate/normalize all fields, especially order_date, priority, ship_country, qty. For v2 treat qty as high risk; for v3 treat order_date as high risk.
- Check attempt number. If attempt 3, submit only after all invalid fields are corrected; otherwise expect manual review.
- If rejection lists multiple invalid fields, correct all before retry.
- Manual review after 3 rejections; continue to next record.

Next batch: full-field validation, attempt count, order_date/priority/ship_country/qty.

Working notes: intake through ORD-5149.

Forms v1-v4 fields same: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country.
Risk: v2 qty; v3 order_date/priority/qty/ship_country; v4 priority/order_date/ship_country/qty. All fields can be invalid; multiple invalid fields common; fixing one may reveal another.

Order_date: v3/v4 slashed DD/MM/YYYY may pass (03/08/2026 v3 only priority+qty invalid; 24/01/2026 v4 only priority invalid). Failing: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, DD.MM.YYYY (e.g., 2026-08-03, 2026-01-24, 2026-08-18, 2026/08/18, 14.03.2026). Need full source; do not infer.

Observed:
- ORD-5140–5149 all rejected -0.20; still no successful auto-intake.
- Priority frequently invalid v3/v4. order_date, priority, qty, ship_country often co-occur. Blank/truncated source can invalidate cust/email too (ORD-5144).
- Source records often truncated voicemail/phone/handwritten/portal; JSON may end mid-field or blank.
- Front-desk notes (“ordinary priority,” “confirmation email,” “duplicate check,” “partner portal,” “handwritten”) are not field validation.
- Attempt 3 rejection sends record to manual review (5141, 5144, 5147).

Rules:
- Before submitting, obtain full source; validate/normalize all fields, especially order_date, priority, ship_country, qty.
- Check attempt number. If attempt 3, submit only after all invalid fields corrected; else expect manual review.
- If rejection lists multiple invalid fields, correct all before retry.
- Manual review after 3 rejections; continue next record.

Next: ORD-5150+, full-field validation, attempt count, form version.

Working notes: intake through ORD-5159.

Forms v1-v4 fields same: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country. All fields can be invalid; multiple invalid fields common; fixing one may reveal another.

Order_date: v3/v4 slashed DD/MM/YYYY can pass (03/08/2026 v3 only priority+qty invalid; 24/01/2026 v4 only priority invalid; v4 18/08/2026, 25/07/2026, 04/03/2026, 14/04/2026 not listed invalid). Failing: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, DD.MM.YYYY (2026-08-03, 2026-01-24, 2026-08-18, 2026/08/18, 14.03.2026). Need full source; do not infer.

Observed:
- ORD-5140–5159 all rejected -0.20; still no successful auto-intake.
- v4 priority frequently invalid; qty and ship_country often co-occur. Sometimes only priority invalid (ORD-5158).
- Source records often truncated voicemail/phone/handwritten/portal/email; JSON may end mid-field or blank. Blank/truncated source can invalidate cust/email too (ORD-5144).
- Front-desk notes (“ordinary priority,” “confirmation email,” “duplicate check,” “partner portal,” “handwritten”) are not field validation.
- Attempt 3 rejection sends record to manual review (5141, 5144, 5147, 5150, 5153, 5156, 5159).

Rules:
- Before submitting, obtain full source; validate/normalize all fields, especially priority, qty, ship_country, order_date.
- Check attempt number. If attempt 3, submit only after all invalid fields corrected; else expect manual review.
- If rejection lists multiple invalid fields, correct all before retry. Rejection sets can vary between retries; re-check all fields.
- Manual review after 3 rejections; continue next record.

Next: ORD-5160+, full-field validation, attempt count, form version v4.
